what_i_see: Straight N-S bar ~3" long, yellow-white with bluer ends, joined by faint knots to a compact bright orange source ~3.4" SW. The bar is not curved or tangential to that source.
most_likely: An edge-on disc galaxy at z~0.7-0.9 near an unrelated or companion compact red galaxy.
against_it: A lens arc would curve around the orange source; this bar is straight and radially oriented.
decisive_test: Spectra of bar and orange source; or check for a counter-image opposite the orange source.
catalogue_notes: Legacy DR8 photo-z: REX z=0.71+/-0.17 at 0.7" and REX z=0.92+/-0.52 at 1.0" (both on bar). Nearest NED WISE ~13"; SIMBAD LEDA 423045 at 25.7". No Gaia within 28". No match in Jacobs+2019, Huang+2020/2021 (cone 10"; Rojas+2022 query unvalidated).
